title: RegisterSession then SendRRData with bounded unconnected GetAttributeSingle
purpose: Reach the explicit-message unconnected parsing path safely using the issue-relevant RegisterSession to SendRRData progression, but keep CPF and CIP lengths internally consistent and path_size bounded.

messages.label: SendRRData with Null Address Item and bounded Unconnected Data Item carrying CIP GetAttributeSingle

expected_behavior: The peer should parse a valid SendRRData encapsulation body and CPF. The embedded CIP request may succeed or may return an ordinary CIP error depending on object support, but it should not require out-of-bounds parsing.
constraints_preserved: SendRRData command 0x006F uses a 22-byte encapsulated payload matching the actual body
Command-specific SendRRData prefix is 6 zero bytes as implied by supplied issue reproduction text
Item 1 is Null Address Item type 0x0000 length 0
Item 2 is Unconnected Data Item type 0x00B2 length 10
Embedded CIP request uses service 0x0E with path_size 3 words and exactly 6 path bytes plus 1-byte attribute segment, matching the declared item length
Session handle is a placeholder for substitution after successful RegisterSession
issue_safety_notes: This is a safe structural analogue for issue 582: it follows the same broad RegisterSession-to-SendRRData-to-explicit-message path but removes the exact historical collision by keeping the Unconnected Data Item length consistent and the CIP path_size small and satisfied by present bytes.
